# Netskope Client Status
Client deployment, health, connectivity (NPA), inventory and device-level investigation, built on the `NetskopeClientStatus_CL` table. Use the filters to scope every panel; switch tabs to change focus.

parameters.name: OperatingSystem
parameters.label: Operating system
parameters.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(host_info_os_name)
| distinct host_info_os_name
| order by host_info_os_name asc

parameters.name: ClientStatus
parameters.label: Client status
parameters.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name)
| distinct last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name
| order by last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name asc

parameters.name: Classification
parameters.label: Device classification
parameters.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(user_info_device_classification_status_name)
| distinct user_info_device_classification_status_name
| order by user_info_device_classification_status_name asc

parameters.name: ClientVersion
parameters.label: Client version
parameters.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(client_version)
| distinct client_version
| order by client_version asc

parameters.name: StaleThreshold
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "1d", "label": "1 day"}, {"value": "3d", "label": "3 days", "selected": true}, {"value": "7d", "label": "7 days"}, {"value": "14d", "label": "14 days"}, {"value": "30d", "label": "30 days"}]
parameters.label: Treat device as stale after

content.query:
let StaleAfter = {StaleThreshold};
let ClientStatusScoped = NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where "*" in ({OperatingSystem}) or host_info_os_name in ({OperatingSystem})
| where "*" in ({ClientStatus}) or last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name in ({ClientStatus})
| where "*" in ({Classification}) or user_info_device_classification_status_name in ({Classification})
| where "*" in ({ClientVersion}) or client_version in ({ClientVersion})
| where "{SearchText}" == "" or host_info_hostname contains "{SearchText}" or user_info_username contains "{SearchText}" or last_connected_from_public_ip contains "{SearchText}"
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| extend ClientStatus = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name), "UNKNOWN", last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name),
         LegacyStatus = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_status_name), "UNKNOWN", last_seen_device_event_status_name),
         NpaStatus = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name), "UNKNOWN", last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name),
         OperatingSystem = iff(isempty(host_info_os_name), "UNKNOWN", host_info_os_name),
         ClientEvent = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_event_name), "UNKNOWN_EVENT", last_seen_device_event_event_name),
         Actor = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_actor_name), "UNKNOWN", last_seen_device_event_actor_name),
         Classification = iff(isempty(user_info_device_classification_status_name), "UNKNOWN", user_info_device_classification_status_name),
         ServiceName = iff(isempty(last_seen_device_event_service_name), "n/a", last_seen_device_event_service_name);
let ClientStatusLatest = ClientStatusScoped | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| extend NeedsAttention = ClientStatus in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "DORMANT")
    or LegacyStatus in ("ERRORED", "BACKED_OFF", "FAIL_CLOSED")
    or NpaStatus in ("UNABLE_TO_ENROLL", "ERRORED")
    or ClientEvent in ("DISCONNECTED_ERROR", "DISCONNECTED_ERROR_MODERN_STANDBY", "DISCONNECTED_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN_ERROR", "INSTALLATION_FAILURE", "UNINSTALLATION_FAILURE", "UPGRADE_FAILURE", "ROLLBACK_FAILURE", "CA_INSTALLATION_FAILURE")
| extend HoursSinceSeen = toint(datetime_diff("hour", now(), TimeGenerated)), IsStale = TimeGenerated < ago(StaleAfter);
union
  (ClientStatusLatest | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "Reporting devices", Order = 1, Trend = toscalar(ClientStatusScoped | summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceKey) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | order by TimeGenerated asc | summarize make_list(Devices))),
  (ClientStatusLatest | summarize Value = countif(ClientStatus == "ENABLED") | extend Metric = "Enabled clients", Order = 2, Trend = toscalar(ClientStatusScoped | where ClientStatus == "ENABLED" | summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceKey) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | order by TimeGenerated asc | summarize make_list(Devices))),
  (ClientStatusLatest | summarize Value = countif(NeedsAttention) | extend Metric = "Needs attention", Order = 3, Trend = toscalar(ClientStatusScoped | where ClientStatus in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "DORMANT") or LegacyStatus in ("ERRORED", "BACKED_OFF", "FAIL_CLOSED") | summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceKey) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | order by TimeGenerated asc | summarize make_list(Devices))),
  (ClientStatusLatest | summarize Value = countif(NpaStatus startswith "CONNECTED") | extend Metric = "NPA connected", Order = 4, Trend = toscalar(ClientStatusScoped | where NpaStatus startswith "CONNECTED" | summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceKey) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | order by TimeGenerated asc | summarize make_list(Devices))),
  (ClientStatusLatest | summarize Value = countif(Classification == "MANAGED") | extend Metric = "Managed devices", Order = 5, Trend = toscalar(ClientStatusScoped | where Classification == "MANAGED" | summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceKey) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | order by TimeGenerated asc | summarize make_list(Devices))),
  (ClientStatusLatest | summarize Value = countif(IsStale) | extend Metric = "Stale devices", Order = 6, Trend = toscalar(ClientStatusScoped | summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceKey) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | order by TimeGenerated asc | summarize make_list(Devices)))
| extend Trend = iff(array_length(Trend) == 0, dynamic([0, 0]), Trend)
| project Metric, Order, Value, Trend
| order by Order asc
